description: Run a shell command on a device through its Connect remote shell and return output + exit code. The shell session persists between calls (cwd, env vars). First call to a device takes ~30s to connect. Commands that wait for input (sudo password, editors, confirmations) will time out; use send_keys/read_screen for those.

device.description: Device name (or unique substring of it) or device UUID, as shown by list_devices

timeout_sec.description: Max seconds to wait for completion

name: run_command
